preconditions.description: The number of rows in the grid is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The number of columns in the grid is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The grid contains only unmarked and marked cells.

preconditions.expression: No marked cell is adjacent to the edge of the grid
preconditions.description: All marked cells are surrounded by unmarked cells.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' to indicate the existence of a suitable grid.
If the output is 'YES', then a valid grid exists that satisfies all conditions.
If the output is 'NO', then no valid grid exists that satisfies all conditions.

invariants.expression: all(cell == '.' or cell == 'X' for row in grid for cell in row)
invariants.description: The grid contains only '.' and 'X' characters.

invariants.expression: all(cell == '.' for row in grid for cell in row if row > 0 and row < n-1 and cell > 0 and cell < m-1)
invariants.description: All unmarked cells are not on the edge of the grid.

invariants.expression: all(grid[i][j] == 'X' ==> (grid[i-1][j] == '.' and grid[i+1][j] == '.' and grid[i][j-1] == '.' and grid[i][j+1] == '.') for i in range(1, n-1) for j in range(1, m-1))
invariants.description: All marked cells are surrounded by unmarked cells.

invariants.expression: all(grid[i][j] == '.' ==> grid[i][j] in {1, 4} for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
invariants.description: Every unmarked cell contains either 1 or 4.

invariants.expression: all(grid[i][j] == 'X' ==> grid[i][j] % 5 == 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
invariants.description: Every marked cell contains a multiple of 5.

invariants.expression: all(grid[i][j] == 'X' ==> sum(grid[x][y] for x in range(n) for y in range(m) if (x, y) is adjacent to (i, j)) % 5 == 0 for i in range(1, n-1) for j in range(1, m-1))
invariants.description: The sum of the numbers in all unmarked cells adjacent to each marked cell is a multiple of 5.
